Plantable Color Pencils (10pc) – Eco-Friendly Seed Pencils with Vibrant Colors

Our Plantable Color Pencils (10pc) Eco-Friendly set is a perfect blend of creativity, sustainability, and responsible gifting. Designed using sustainable construction and innovative plantable technology, these 10 full-size coloring seed pencils offer an enriching experience for children, adults, artists, and eco-conscious brands. Each pencil is crafted from recycled paper and embedded with high-quality seeds, allowing you to plant the stubs and watch them grow into herbs, flowers, or vegetables. These eco-friendly color pencils reduce plastic waste and help promote green living.

The pack is ideal for schools, corporate giveaways, return gifts, and promotional events emphasizing sustainability. The smooth color output, vibrant colors, and comfortable grip make them suitable for everyday coloring, sketching, and art projects. Once the pencils become too short to use, simply plant them in soil, water regularly, and enjoy the joy of germination.
